paper.title: SleepECG: A Python package for sleep staging based on heart rate
paper.claim: The shipped WRN-GRU classifier predicts NREM, REM, or wake for each thirty-second epoch from heart-rate features and participant metadata.
paper.population: The model was trained on 1,971 MESA nights and author-tested on 1,000 SHHS nights; this reproduction uses 18 SLPDB records from 16 all-male participants evaluated for apnea or CPAP.
paper.referenceStandard: PSG sleep-stage annotations distributed with SLPDB, mapped to the model's three-class wake, REM, and NREM ontology.
paper.relationEvidence: SleepECG 0.5.9 is the BSD-licensed package described by the software paper and ships the checksum-pinned WRN-GRU model, training script, feature contract, and reported external metrics.

sources.name: SleepECG 0.5.9 source distribution and embedded model

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed full-night beat-interval sleep-staging contract
compatibility.window: Thirty-second epochs with 120-second lookback and 150-second lookforward.
compatibility.preprocessing: Use 0.3–2.0 second intervals, at most fifty percent missing values, SleepECG time and frequency HRV features, recording start time, age, and binary gender.
mismatches: External SLPDB accuracy is 0.573618 with kappa 0.123670 and REM F1 0.199796.
SLPDB contains only sixteen all-male participants evaluated for apnea or CPAP.
The model requires age and binary gender as sensitive features.
Brainstem full-night intervals have not been calibrated against this pipeline.
Brainstem recordings do not carry independent PSG reference labels.

cohort.output: Withheld; the public reproduction documents insufficient external transfer and does not authorize Brainstem sleep-stage distributions.

personal.output: Withheld; no personal sleep-stage label, sleep score, condition inference, chart, or free-text proxy may be returned.
